theorem selected_column_transport {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) :
    let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
    let r : ℝ := (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) * ((s - 1) / (s + 1))
    let ℓ : ℝ := (4 * (n : ℝ) * s + (s - 1) ^ 2) /
      (8 * (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let c : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
      fun O => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i j0)
    let ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := (orthogonalHaar n).map c
    let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun y =>
      ((s + 1) * WithLp.ofLp y j0 - (s - 1)) /
        (1 + r ^ 2 - 2 * r * WithLp.ofLp y j0) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
    IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
      (∀ᵐ y ∂ν, ‖y‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ Q : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        ν.map (fun y => Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin n) (Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) y) = ν) ∧
      Integrable f ν ∧
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
          (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖x‖ ^ 2) ∂γ O)
        ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
        (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (s - 1) ^ (n - 1)) / (s + 1) ^ n) *
          (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * (∫ y, f y ∂ν)

definition_audit.s,r,ell,j0: Literal source selected parameters; dimension in r/ell coerced to real before subtraction/division.

definition_audit.nu: Literal pushforward of unchanged actual normalized full O(n) Haar along c; not an arbitrary probability or canonical normalized surface measure by definition.
definition_audit.f: Literal real half-power normalized scalar kernel on ambient EuclideanSpace; possibly singular away from support, so only ae measurability/integrability is required and produced internally. No global positivity claim.
definition_audit.gamma: Actual multivariateGaussian zero inverse of literal singleBlockPrecision; unchanged canonical construction.
definition_audit.orthogonalHaar: Unchanged characterized actual normalized full-group Haar, including both determinant components.
definition_audit.rotation: Actual matrix action Matrix.toEuclideanCLM, no abstract assumed action/invariance.
